newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU grants free-mkt soft wheat, barley with refunds.
newsitem.headline: EU grants free-mkt soft wheat, barley with refunds.

text.p: The European Union on Thursday granted licences to export 133,350 tonnes of free-market soft wheat at a maximum refund of 5.99 Ecus per tonne through its main tender programme, a member country official said.
It also awarded licences to export 5,000 tonnes of free-market barley at a maximum refund of 27.14 Ecus per tonne, he said.
In a separate tender the EU granted the export of 3,000 tonnes of free-market soft wheat at a maximum refund of 8.50 Ecus per tonne to African, Caribbean and Pacific countries.
The European Union also awarded licences to export 6,000 tonnes of free-market rye at a maximum refund of 22.00 Ecus per tonne to non-EU countries.
But the EU refused bids to export free-market oats with subsidies.
Exporters in Scandinavia had bid to export 112,000 tonnes of EU oats at refunds ranging from 35.05 to 42.05 Ecus per tonne. The oats were mostly destined for the U.S., grain industry sources said.
